//: Servers that are built but not yet live. NOT read by scripts/build.mjs and NOT part of the Agent Plugins spec - this file exists because mcp.schema.json closes the root object to $schema and mcpServers, so staged entries cannot be parked inside mcp.json itself.
//why: A manifest entry pointing at a server that is not serving surfaces in every client as a per-session connection failure, so a server is declared only once its URL answers.
//promote: Move an entry into mcpServers in mcp.json, delete it here, run `npm run build`. That emits .mcp.json (the mcp-remote stdio bridge), gemini-extension.json, and the mcpServers pointers in the Cursor and Codex manifests. Reversing the edit deletes them again.
